provider: TradingView anonymous quote-cache snapshot carrying OSE exact-Micro metadata
product_requirement: Individual Osaka Exchange Nikkei 225 micro Futures contract, e.g. OSE:NK225MCU2026. Continuous NK225MC1! may be context only and is not used as the scored reference when an individual front contract is available.

browser_dependency.legacy_browser_transport: Retained only as a diagnostic fallback outside the formal cloud path.
browser_dependency.cloud_primary_transport: HTTPS POST to TradingView quote_cache_http snapshot endpoint.

freshness_rule.timestamp_rule: Use TradingView quote-cache lp_time epoch carried with the OSE delayed-streaming quote. Do not substitute browser receive time, HTTP Date, bid/ask time, or page-render time.

scored_forecast_rule: Reference source must be an individual exact OSE Micro contract from the TradingView quote-cache transport, source_id=OSE, continuous_contract=false, and freshness_age_seconds<=900 at forecast build/registration.
outcome_rule: Target day-session close must remain exact-product and independently timestamped; the quote-cache transport may be used only when the target-close timestamp/market-state conditions in the outcome protocol are met.
